source_fact_map.fact: At an August 8, 2017 Bedminster press exchange, Trump responded to a question about North Korea’s nuclear capabilities by warning that further threats would be met with “fire and fury like the world has never seen.”
source_fact_map.quote: North Korea best not make any more threats to the United States. They will be met with fire and fury like the world has never seen.
source_fact_map.source_excerpt: Q Any comment on the reports about North Korea’s nuclear capabilities? THE PRESIDENT: North Korea best not make any more threats to the United States. They will be met with fire and fury like the world has never seen.
